items.title: Xavier Worthy: Five catches in Week 2 win
items.body_text: Worthy brought in five of seven targets for 25 yards and a touchdown in the Chiefs' 33-30 overtime win over the Colts on Sunday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Travis Kelce: Signature showing in OT win
items.body_text: Kelce secured nine of 11 targets for 101 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 33-30 overtime win over the Colts on Sunday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Vintage performance in OT win
items.body_text: Mahomes completed 32 of 47 passes for 382 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing twice for 17 yards in the Chiefs' 33-30 overtime win over the Colts on Sunday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kenneth Walker: Thrives with massive workload
